summary: Incremental acceptance of e1a39e112de3fcf928ef37fc813c7e70704acf30 against prior accepted 1f1e769. All three prior MINOR findings are closed: (1) the all-unconfigured waiver regression now commits both a backend and a frontend file under config={}, asserts check_kinds yields both classes (exercising the len(kinds)>1 missing-suite pre-check), asserts checks exits 2 with the new waive-permitting blocker clause, then waive→checks records waived with zero model calls; the run_checks blocker wording now explicitly permits waive only when all applicable checks are absent, exactly matching waiver_valid/unit_has_checks semantics. (2) cmd_checks prints an explicit 'Авторская фиксация: <author> <full SHA>' announcement whenever the binding is recorded, and SKILL.md step 3 now requires the author to verify HEAD is the intended submission before checks; the both-direction handoff regression asserts the announcement. (3) The _do_review SHA-mismatch refusal now includes the stored binding (author+SHA via json.dumps) and current HEAD, and offers switching back to the already-bound SHA before requesting a new author fixation; the regression asserts the recorded SHA and switch-back phrase with rc=2 and zero calls. Exact-SHA enforcement is unchanged: direct_author_subject, the binding condition (not cand_mode and LEAD==author, after apply_checks so a blocker still prevents binding), cand_mode exclusion, and all fail-closed ordering in _do_review are byte-identical in logic; executable deltas are two message strings and one say() line. Existing cross-class blocker-text assertions remain satisfied. No concrete regressions; two new MINOR guidance/coverage notes (null-binding wording in the refusal message; the mixed-waiver regression stops before review/finish). Unchanged executable code remains covered by the prior accepted SHA. PASS.

findings.problem: The new _do_review refusal message unconditionally renders 'зафиксировано {json.dumps(u.get("direct_author"))}' and 'Переключись на уже зафиксированный SHA' even when no binding exists, producing 'зафиксировано null ... Переключись на уже зафиксированный SHA'. The prior fix suggestion was to keep only the author-checks instruction when no binding exists; the first clause ('прямую реализацию фиксирует чат автора ... командой checks') is retained, but the null dump and the switch-back option are misleading in the unbound case.
findings.scenario: Fresh direct unit, author has never run checks and never reviewed; a non-author coordinator runs review. The refusal prints 'зафиксировано null' and suggests switching to a bound SHA that does not exist, alongside the correct author-checks instruction. Fail-closed behavior is unchanged and test_direct_wrong_lead_cannot_self_review still passes (it only asserts 'чат автора qwen'), but the coordinator may waste a round-trip looking for a nonexistent fixation.
findings.fix: Branch the message on whether u.get('direct_author') is a dict: when present, include the recorded author/SHA and the switch-back option as now; when absent, keep only the original author-checks instruction ('... командой checks <uid>; после этого любой координатор может отправить тот же SHA на review'). Optionally add an assertion in test_direct_wrong_lead_cannot_self_review that the unbound refusal does not contain 'зафиксировано null'.

findings.problem: The extended all-unconfigured multi-class waiver regression stops at checks reporting waived; it never drives the blessed end-to-end path (review with scripted PASS, then finish) for a mixed-class waived unit. The waived checks record written by apply_checks contains no 'suites' key, and checks_cover defaults recorded suites to a single class, so acceptance-time coverage handling of a waived two-class unit is exercised by no supplied test; SKILL.md explicitly promises this path ('waive ... допустим и для смешанной единицы', finish accepts 'обоснованного waive').
findings.scenario: A future edit to ensure_full/full_green or checks_cover starts requiring recorded suite coverage even for waived checks. A mixed direct unit touching backend+frontend under config={} would then block at finish despite a valid waiver, contradicting SKILL.md, and no focused test would fail because the new regression ends at the waived checks flag. The engine logic is unchanged in this diff and was accepted previously, so this is a coverage gap, not a demonstrated defect.
findings.fix: Extend test_all_unconfigured_classes_can_be_waived (or add a sibling test) to script the opposite-service reviewer with PASS, run review and finish after the waived checks, and assert exit 0 with exactly one model call — locking the full waived-mixed acceptance path that the new blocker wording and SKILL.md paragraph now explicitly authorize.
